g.text: Entry points
External
Core
State
boot.py · every wake: static 192.168.0.71 join, then falls into main.py
boot.py guard · compares isconnected to False, so the 5 min retry never fires
main.py · NTP time, connect, retained heartbeat twice, subscribe, poll 20 s, sleep
main_loop · check_msg until 20 s elapsed, then main_shutdown, deepsleep 300 s
main.py · cloud calls are all commented out, only doLocal=True runs
dev loop · rsync src over rshell to /pyboard, then ctrl-D soft reboot on ttyUSB0
home wifi · static address means nothing here answers DHCP
192.168.0.54:8883 · TLS, no username, no certificate check
brave/phone/battery and brave/tablet/battery · published by MacroDroid on the devices
Meross mss425f surge protector · four sockets plus USB on channels 1 to 5
ntptime · sets the clock the SET frame timestamp is signed with
iot.meross.com and mqtt-eu-2 · the abandoned cloud route, unreachable from here
local_recv · topic part 1 is the device, the payload is the battery percent
local_recv · over 60 turns the relay off, under 40 on, 40 to 60 is left alone
local_recv · tablet is channel 1, phone is channel 3, anything else is dropped
meross_toggle · one ToggleX SET to the hardcoded plug uuid, called twice
meross_mqtt_build · header plus togglex payload, md5 sign, epoch seconds
fake=True · signs messageId+timestamp and rewrites creds to fakeid, no ack is counted
handleAckTimer · 3 s one-shot republish, expectAcks minus one, only on the real path
nextstage login · Base64 params, md5(secret+ts+nonce+params), token and key back
derived ids · app_id md5(API+uuid4), mqtt_pw md5(user_id+key), topic app uid-appid
creds.py · gitignored: lan_ssid, lan_pw, email, password, cached_creds
module globals · doLocal, doSleep, expectAcks, our_timers
module globals · client_id, app_id, mqtt_pw, uuid, creds, overwritten by fake sends
ca.crt and flash/cert/ca.pem · self-signed CN=LOQMQTT, referenced by no live code
no NVS write · deep sleep wipes RAM, only broker-retained heartbeat outlives a cycle
